tagline: Drop your event photos in, add a few notes, and let Claude arrange them into a story. Pick a format, hit render — the same polished WSTI look, every time.
voice: WSTI (Western Sydney Tech Innovators) is a 3,400+ member community in Western Sydney focused on hands-on AI and emerging tech. The brand voice is warm, human, energetic and inclusive — proud of its people, never corporate or stiff. Celebrate the people, the energy, the curiosity, and Western Sydney pride.
